Addison's disease causes hyperpigmentation, not hypopigmentation. Due to adrenal insufficiency, cortisol levels fall, leading to increased ACTH production. ACTH has melanocyte-stimulating activity, resulting in diffuse skin and mucosal hyperpigmentation.

The other options cause hypopigmentation:

  • Albinism → generalized reduction/absence of melanin

  • Vitiligo → depigmented patches due to melanocyte loss

  • Pityriasis versicolor → hypo- or hyperpigmented macules due to Malassezia

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Albinism → Hypopigmentation

  • Vitiligo → Depigmentation

  • Pityriasis versicolor → Hypo/hyperpigmentation

  • Addison's disease → Hyperpigmentation ⭐

Exam Pearl: Addison = bronze skin → hyperpigmentation.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০০) Which is not a criteria of heart myocardial tissue?
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
Cardiac muscle is striated, contains intercalated discs, and typically has one centrally placed nucleus (occasionally two). Therefore, multiple nuclei is not a characteristic feature of cardiac muscle.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Cardiac muscle → Striated

  • → Intercalated discs present

  • → Central nucleus

  • Usually single nucleus

  • Skeletal muscle → Multiple peripheral nuclei

Exam Pearl: Multiple peripheral nuclei = skeletal muscle, not cardiac muscle.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০১) _____ English are industrious.
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The correct sentence is:

“The English are industrious.”

Here, “the English” refers to the English people as a whole, so the definite article “the” is used before a nationality adjective when referring to the people collectively.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • The English → English people collectively

  • The French → French people

  • The Japanese → Japanese people

  • “English” as a language → English (no article)

Exam Pearl: The + adjective can refer to a whole class of people → “The English.”

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০২) Everyone should respect _____ teachers.
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The traditional grammatically correct form is:

“Everyone should respect one's teachers.”

Everyone is an indefinite pronoun referring to each person individually. Therefore, one's is used as the corresponding possessive form.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • One → one's

  • He → his

  • She → her

  • They → their

  • Everyone → traditionally one's in formal grammar

Exam Pearl: Everyone → one's in traditional exam-style grammar questions.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০৩) Choose the correct sentence.
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option2: He speaks the English like English
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option3: He speaks English like the English
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option4: He speaks the English like the English
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
• English as a language is generally used without an article → “He speaks English.”

  • the English refers to English people collectively → “the English.”

Therefore, “He speaks English like the English” is grammatically correct and means that he speaks English like an English person.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Language → English (no article)

  • People → the English

  • Example → “She speaks French like the French.”

Exam Pearl: Language = no article; nationality group = “the + adjective.”

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০৪) Which one is adjective?
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
“Diplomatic” is an adjective. It describes something related to diplomacy or a diplomat, e.g., diplomatic relations or diplomatic immunity.

  • Diploma → Noun

  • Diplomatic → Adjective ⭐

  • Diplomacy → Noun

  • Diplomat → Noun

Exam Pearl: Diplomatic = adjective; Diplomacy/Diplomat/Diploma = nouns.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০৫) This an exception ____ the rule, we need.
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The correct expression is “an exception to the rule.”

So the sentence should be:

“This is an exception to the rule we need.”

The preposition “to” is conventionally used after exception when referring to something that does not follow a rule, principle, or general pattern.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Exception to the rule ✅

  • Exception to the norm

  • Exception to the principle

Exam Pearl: Exception + to = fixed collocation.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০৬) The phrase 'out and out' means...
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The idiom “out and out” means completely, thoroughly, or in every respect.

Example:

  • “He is an out-and-out liar.” → He is a complete/utter liar.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Out and out → Completely / thoroughly ⭐

  • Not at all → By no means

  • Partially → Partly / in part

  • Incomplete → Imperfect / unfinished

Exam Pearl: Out and out = completely / thoroughly.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০৭) The synonym of word 'hostile' is..
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
Hostile means unfriendly, antagonistic, or showing opposition. Among the given options, “enemy” is the closest in meaning, although strictly speaking, enemy is a noun while hostile is an adjective.

  • Hostile → unfriendly / antagonistic / adverse

  • Amicable → friendly 

  • Friendly → opposite of hostile 

  • Slowly → unrelated 

  • Enemy → closest available option 

Exam Pearl: Hostile = unfriendly / antagonistic; “enemy” is the closest option here.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০৮) Which of the following is a correct sentence?
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option1: One of my friends are a lawyer
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option2: One of my friends is a lawyer
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option3: One of my friend is a lawyer
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option4: One of my friends are lawyer
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The phrase “one of my friends” means one person from a group of friends. Therefore:

  • “friends” must be plural because it follows “one of my.”

  • The subject is “one,” which is singular, so the verb must be “is.”

  • “a lawyer” is correct because lawyer is a singular countable noun.

 One of my friends is a lawyer.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • One of + plural noun → one of my friends

  • Verb agrees with one → is

  • Singular profession → a lawyer

Exam Pearl: One of + plural noun + singular verb.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১০৯) He works hard that he may succeed. Here 'that' is a...
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
In the sentence “He works hard that he may succeed,” “that” connects the main clause “He works hard” with the subordinate clause “he may succeed.”

Here, that introduces a purpose clause, meaning “so that.” Therefore, it functions as a conjunction.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • That + clause → Conjunction

  • “He works hard that he may succeed.” → purpose

  • “I know that he is honest.” → conjunction

  • “The book that I bought is new.” → relative pronoun

Exam Pearl: When that joins two clauses, it commonly functions as a conjunction.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১০) What kind of noun is 'man'?
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
“Man” is a common noun because it refers to a human being in general, not to a particular individual.

  • Man → Common noun ✅

  • Dhaka → Proper noun

  • Honesty → Abstract noun

  • Team → Collective noun

Exam Pearl: A noun naming a person, place, animal, or thing in general is a common noun.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১১) 'I must do this'. Choose correct negative form of this sentence.
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The sentence “I must do this” expresses strong necessity or compulsion. Its equivalent negative construction is:

“I cannot help doing this.”

Here, cannot help + gerund (-ing) means “cannot avoid doing something” or “must do it.”

  • I cannot help doing this. 

  • I cannot help do this. 

  • I must not do this.  → means the opposite: I am prohibited from doing this.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Must do → cannot help doing

  • Cannot help + V-ing

  • Must not do → should not / be prohibited from doing

Exam Pearl: “I must do this” = “I cannot help doing this.”

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১২) 'Enter the house by this gate'. Right passive voice of this sentence is-
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option1: you are requested to enter the house by this gate
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option3: let the house be entered by this gate
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).option4: let the house be entered by you by this gate
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The sentence “Enter the house by this gate” is an imperative sentence. To change an imperative sentence into passive voice, we generally use:

Let + object + be + past participle (V³)

  • Active: Enter the house by this gate.

  • Passive: Let the house be entered by this gate. 

Option D is unnecessarily awkward because “by you” is not required when the doer is obvious.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Imperative active → Let + object + be + V³

  • “Open the door.” → Let the door be opened.

  • “Do the work.” → Let the work be done.

Exam Pearl: Imperative passive = Let + object + be + past participle.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১৩) He advised me _____ smoking.
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
he verb “advise” can be followed by an object + gerund (-ing):

advise + object + V-ing

So the correct sentence is:

“He advised me giving up smoking.” 

However, this wording is not standard English. The grammatically correct construction is:

“He advised me to give up smoking.” 

Therefore, among the given options, B) to give up is the correct answer.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Advise + object + to + verb → “He advised me to give up smoking.”

  • Advise + V-ing → “He advised giving up smoking.” (no object)

  • advise + me + to give 

  • advise + me + giving 

Exam Pearl: Advise + object → to-infinitive.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১৪) They gave me a form and told me-
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The correct phrasal verb is “fill in”, meaning to complete a form by providing the required information.

“They gave me a form and told me to fill in.”
More naturally: “They gave me a form and told me to fill it in.”

  • Fill in → complete a form/document 

  • Fill → incomplete construction here

  • Fell into → incorrect meaning

  • Fill into → incorrect expression

Exam Pearl: Fill in a form = complete a form.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১৫) Which of the following means 'unlimited power'?
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
Omnipotence means unlimited or infinite power.

  • Omnipotence → unlimited power ⭐

  • Omnipotent → having unlimited power

  • Omnipresent → present everywhere

  • Omniscient → knowing everything

Exam Pearl: Omnipotence = unlimited power; Omniscience = unlimited knowledge; Omnipresence = being everywhere.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১৬) 'Merchant of Venice' is written by-
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The Merchant of Venice is a famous comedy by William Shakespeare, written around the late 16th century.

  • W. Shakespeare → The Merchant of Venice 

  • G. B. Shaw → Pygmalion, Arms and the Man

  • Ben Jonson → Volpone

  • John Keats → Famous Romantic poet; Ode to a Nightingale

Exam Pearl: The Merchant of Venice → William Shakespeare.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১৭) The poem 'The Solitary Reaper' is written by-
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
“The Solitary Reaper” is a famous poem by William Wordsworth, one of the major poets of the English Romantic period. The poem describes a young Highland girl singing alone while reaping grain in a field.

  • W. Wordsworth → The Solitary Reaper 

  • W. H. Auden → The Unknown Citizen

  • W. B. Yeats → The Second Coming

  • Ezra Pound → In a Station of the Metro

Exam Pearl: The Solitary Reaper → William Wordsworth.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১৮) Nissim Ezekiel is a famous poet of-
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Nissim Ezekiel → India ??

  • Famous poem → Night of the Scorpion

  • Known for → Indian English poetry

Exam Pearl: Nissim Ezekiel = Indian poet.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১১৯) Elizabethan Tragedy is centered on-
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
Elizabethan tragedy is strongly associated with the theme of revenge. Many major tragedies of the period revolve around revenge, moral conflict, violence, and the consequences of seeking vengeance.

A classic example is Shakespeare's Hamlet, which is fundamentally a revenge tragedy.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Elizabethan tragedy → Revenge ⭐

  • Hamlet → Revenge tragedy

  • Other themes → Ambition, jealousy, betrayal, supernatural elements

Exam Pearl: Elizabethan tragedy = predominantly centered on revenge.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১২০) 'Sweet are the uses of adversity' was stated by-
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:
The famous line “Sweet are the uses of adversity” appears in William Shakespeare’s comedy As You Like It. It is spoken by Duke Senior in Act II, Scene I.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • “Sweet are the uses of adversity” → Shakespeare

  • Work → As You Like It

  • Speaker → Duke Senior

Exam Pearl: Sweet are the uses of adversity → Shakespeare → As You Like It.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১২১) Kyoto Protocol কোন দেশে স্বাক্ষরিত হয়?

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১২২) ২০১৮ ফুটবল বিশ্বকাপজয়ী অধিনায়কের নাম কী?
Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).exp:

Exam Pearl: 2018 World Cup Champion → France → Captain → Hugo Lloris.

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১২৩) 'India wins Freedom' এর রচয়িতা কে?

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১২৪) OIC কোন সালে প্রতিষ্ঠিত হয়?

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১২৫) ইউরোপিয়ান কেন্দ্রীয় ব্যাংকের সদর দফতর কোথায় অবস্থিত?

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১২৬) ICRC এর প্রতিষ্ঠাতা কে ছিলেন?

Final Model Test-03 (২০০ নাম্বার).question: ১২৭) শতকরা হিসেবে সার্কভুক্ত কোন দেশে বনভূমির পরিমাণ সবচেয়ে বেশি?
